description: Draw a custom card ONLY when no other tool returns the visual the user wants and show_card cannot do it. Every number must be copied from results of the other tools in this conversation; NEVER invent, estimate or compute new figures. type: kpi (up to 4 labelled numbers), bar (1 to 12), line (2 to 12 points in order). Pass labels and values (same length; values are plain numbers like 1250.5, no commas or units); fmt is money, int, pct or mins. Tables are not available here: use show_card with the matching tool. At most 3 composed cards per reply.

parameters.label: Values
parameters.description: kpi/bar/line: plain numbers as text, e.g. "1250.5" (no commas or units), taken from tool results.

parameters.label: Fmt
parameters.description: How to show the values. Default int.

parameters.label: Subtitle
parameters.description: Optional, e.g. the period. Up to 80 characters.
